question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom:

 Lives within his means
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Manages expenses carefully. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Lives within his means"** refers to someone who spends only what they can afford, without exceeding their income or financial capacity. (अपनी आय के अनुसार खर्च करना) • **Example:** John lives within his means and never buys expensive items he cannot afford. • **"Manages expenses carefully"** (खर्चों को सावधानीपूर्वक प्रबंधित करना) is the correct interpretation of the idiom. It signifies someone who budgets and ensures their spending does not exceed their earnings. • **Example:** Despite earning a modest salary, Sarah manages her expenses carefully and even saves for emergencies. • Hence, the idiom **"Lives within his means"** aligns perfectly with **Option 3**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Manages expenses carefully. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Avoids social contact** (सामाजिक संपर्क से बचना): Refers to someone who prefers isolation or avoids interacting with others. • **Example:** After the incident, she avoided social contact and stayed home most of the time. • **Option 2: Spends lavishly** (फिजूलखर्ची करना): Refers to someone who spends money extravagantly or unnecessarily. • **Example:** Despite having a limited budget, he spends lavishly on luxury items. • **Option 4: Relies on others** (दूसरों पर निर्भर रहना): Refers to someone who depends on others for support, especially financially or emotionally. • **Example:** Instead of finding a job, he relies on others for his expenses. 32:T862, The correct answer is **option 2.**
